appDescription: A vehicle consumables log that records the odometer reading at each replacement and shows the distance driven since then against a distance the driver sets.

function.name: GET_CONSUMABLE_STATUS
function.description: Report the distance driven since the last recorded replacement of one consumable item and the share left of the replacement distance the driver set.

item.description: The consumable item to look up. Tires are recorded separately for each wheel position.

function.name: LIST_CONSUMABLES_BY_REMAINING
function.description: List the consumable items with the smallest share left of the replacement distance the driver set.

function.name: OPEN_CONSUMABLE_RECORD
function.description: Open the replacement record screen of one consumable item in the app.

item.description: The consumable item whose record screen to open. Tires are recorded separately for each wheel position.
